nodes.text:
Somebody is cutting in the old wood, and has been for two seasons, and is moving great sticks through my boom in the dark.

Out the Wardline gate. Follow the blazed pine north-east until the moss stops closing over the ground. Find the cut.

Then you use your judgement, and I will not write down what I think your judgement will be.

They will have men on the approach. Take that as the answer to whether they will talk.
The watch is a sawyer, a carter, and somebody's aunt, and they are all on the tower tonight because the tower is what they are for. I am not sending Kettil into the old wood with a pike-pole.
Bring me the stone. There will be one. Whoever they are, they pulled up the line and they did not throw it away, because men like that never do.
Then it stands another season. It has stood two.
